summary: TikZ version 2 compiles, passes topology check (no missing edges), and received a critic score of 0.95 with no must-repair issues. It draws rectangle ABCD with M on AD, F on DC, E and N on BC, segments AE, MN, BF, FN, a right-angle mark at the foot of the perpendicular on AE, and labels A–F, M, N, O. Line width is 1.3pt.
